metadata.title: Peruvian National Agricultural Survey (ENA), Chapter 600: Unified Dataset on Agricultural and Livestock Waste Management Practices, 2014–2025
metadata.description: This dataset compiles the Chapter 600 records of the Peruvian National Agricultural Survey (Encuesta Nacional Agropecuaria, ENA), conducted by the Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI), unified across survey editions into a single table of 306,966 records and 47 variables. It documents how agricultural producers manage crop residues and livestock manure (for example, use as organic fertilizer or fodder, leaving in the field, burning, or improper disposal), together with contextual variables on region, department, survey year, and access to information and certification. The 2014–2015 waste-management responses are not comparable with those from 2016 onward because the questionnaire changed. Original data are public INEI microdata; this deposit adds harmonization and documentation only. Code: https://github.com/Anyell0w/gestion_residuos_agricolas_ena
